video_title: FOUR PICKS for Jaylen Brown⁉️ Celtics' asking price + Who won the NBA Draft? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Pistons prioritizing restricted free agent Jalen Duren
quotes.excerpt: one of the biggest Pistons priorities right now in free agency is restricted free agent Jalen Duren
quotes.quote: One of the biggest Pistons priorities right now in free agency is restricted free agent Jalen Duren. The sides clearly have not come to an agreement yet. It looks like it is going into the free agency period come June 30th and July 1st. But in the meantime, the Pistons are scouring the market for players out there.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics actively discussing trade packages for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics are actively discussing Jaylen Brown deals around the league
quotes.quote: The Celtics are actively discussing Jaylen Brown deals around the league. From my understanding, sources tell me that the Celtics asking price depending on the team ranges up to four first-round picks at least in a trade for Jaylen Brown. They pursued Giannis Antetokounmpo. We know about that and Jaylen Brown was involved in those trade talks as well as other first-round pick considerations as well.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade value is split between analytics and eye test
quotes.excerpt: it's a matter of what teams you talk to. I think it's the analytics versus the eye test.
quotes.quote: It's all over the place. I think it's a matter of what teams you talk to. I think it's the analytics versus the eye test. The analytics are not great. When you look at Jaylen Brown the last four years, Boston's net rating is better with him off the court. This past year, they were plus 10 when Brown was off the court. However, I am an eye test person. So when you go eye test, this is what I see: a top-10 player in the NBA, 29 years old, in the prime of his career, on a three-year contract without a player option, and has played at least 60 games in four out of the last five years. So you know what you're getting with Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown is a top-10 player who shouldn't be traded
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is a top-10 player in this league. And if you can't get another top-10 player
quotes.quote: I'm more of an eye test person. Jaylen Brown is a top-10 player in this league. And if you can't get another top-10 player or top-20 player for him, I think you're losing out. And now Giannis Antetokounmpo is off the table, what are you looking for? Why are we still dangling him out here unless you for sure have a certain U-turn or reroute of a person or pieces that makes sense? There are teams that we'll discuss later on, but I just don't see it. Unless somebody else is willing to give up another franchise guy for Boston, why would you break up this duo that has shown that they've been successful over the last two or three years?

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's public persona creates unnecessary sensitivity around his trade value
quotes.excerpt: there is a hypersensitivity to Jaylen Brown. And he has embraced it, willing to be the villain
quotes.quote: There is a hypersensitivity to Jaylen Brown. And he has embraced it, willing to be the villain at times, being the bad guy on the court, the one calling out the league and obviously snapping back or clapping back at our own friend Stephen A. Smith. I think there's a sensitivity because of the podcast or the twitch streams and that narrative that confuses people from what he's actually doing. I didn't even know the numbers were like that with Jaylen Brown. I don't even care about it. I'm the first person that would care about it.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland is a potential wild card for a Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: I think Portland is the wild card for the whole summer, not just with Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: When you have a new owner, they are the ultimate wild card. Mikhail Prokhorov that year wanted to go get Carmelo Anthony. They want a star. And you know who I'm looking at? Portland. New owner in Tom Dundon here, where the Trail Blazers are. They've got draft picks. They've got five tradable firsts. If they're looking for that paint presence, is it Donovan Clingan here? They certainly have the salary to go out and make a deal here and I think Portland is the wild card for the whole summer, not just with Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics realized their roster is not good enough after playoff loss
quotes.excerpt: when they take a big picture, take a step back, they realize that this roster is not good enough.
quotes.quote: Listen, they were up 3-1 against Philadelphia and I think when they take a big picture, take a step back, they realize that this roster is not good enough. So how do you address if it's splitting up? It's hard to do. It's hard. You look at what he did this year, as Hannah said, he carried this team elsewhere, maybe is what they're looking for. It depends on what you value, right?

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks nailed the draft with Nate Ament and Brayden Burris
quotes.excerpt: I think they nailed the draft with Nate Ament and Brayden Burris.
quotes.quote: I thought closure with Giannis Antetokounmpo. I think they nailed the draft with Nate Ament and Brayden Burris.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder and Spurs had the best draft outcomes
quotes.excerpt: outside of Milwaukee, I'm going to say the rich get richer. I'm going to go OKC and San Antonio.
quotes.quote: Outside of Milwaukee, I'm going to say the rich get richer. I'm going to go OKC and San Antonio. Getting those big men were key. They were loading up all day.
